mechanism: Lisinopril may potentiate fluphenazine's hypotensive effects and both agents can cause orthostatic hypotension; fluphenazine may also increase anticholinergic effects affecting fluid/electrolyte balance relevant to ACE inhibitor therapy.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, counsel on orthostatic precautions, and assess renal function and electrolytes periodically; consider dose adjustment if hypotension develops.
